thread:
maria: Heads-up — EU prod is seeing a sudden uptick in long-context requests since the campaign went live. p50 seq_len ~512 -> ~1.9k, p95 ~2k -> ~7.6k. Most of this is streaming chat sessions. Can we get a quick GPU-hour impact estimate and decide on a short hedge?

infra-bot: metric snapshot — EU streaming-qps +18% over last 2h; avg tokens/session +3.6x; kv-cache hit-rate dropped ~14%. Prometheus panel: https://grafana/redwood/eu/streaming (snip).

aj: On it. Quick clarifying q: is the traffic spike volume-driven or just context-length shift?

maria: Mostly context-length. Volume +6% only. The new feature appends long chat history + attachments, so clients are sending more prefix and we stream incremental tokens.

kevin: Quick back-of-envelope: for streaming workloads we assume ~1.2M tokens/GPU-hour (this is our median for the Llama-optimized runtime at EU settings). If we look at 100k requests/hour baseline:
- Before: avg tokens/request ~512 -> ~51.2M tokens/hr -> ~43 GPU-equivalent
- Now: avg tokens/request ~1.9k -> ~190M tokens/hr -> ~158 GPU-equivalent
Delta ~= +115 GPU-equivalent for that 100k req/hr baseline.
(This matches the metric that token-hour consumption is ~3.7x on the long requests.)

sylvia: If we need to hedge 115 GPUs for even a 3-hour surge, cost ballpark = 115 * 3 * $2.60 ~= $897 for on-demand A100-style pricing. If we reserve short-term burst pools (dedicated), unit cost goes down but lead time increases.

aj: Two levers: 1) short-term prewarm/burst in eu-west for 6h, 2) routing some sessions to a quantized model shard to cut GPU-hours. Also need to consider AZ networking: cross-AZ egress and peering limits might throttle KV warmups.

kevin: Quantized variant (8-bit + smaller kv-page) reduces token throughput cost ~2.1x in our benchmarks for these long sequences. If we route 40% of long-context sessions to quantized variant, that drops the delta GPUs from 115 -> ~69.

infra-bot: infra alert: eu-west prewarm capacity available: 80 GPUs in burst pool (20 already reserved). Current autoscale max=160 GPUs, current usage=98.

maria: Good. Proposal: prewarm +40 GPUs from burst pool for next 8 hours, enable routing 40% of long sessions to quantized variant, and raise autoscale max to 220 while we monitor. If latency regresses, rollback routing.

kevin: I can push the routing change and add a fast-fallback to full-precision model on error < 300ms. Also will add a KV prefetch job to warm top-K prefixes (won't warm full cache, just 90th percentile prefixes).

aj: I'll open a capacity ticket and schedule the prewarm: ticket INF-4829. Plan: allocate 40 GPUs from burst pool at 09:00 UTC for 8h, set autoscale max to 220, set alert if gpu_util > 92% for 5m.

sylvia: Also set a cost guard: if estimated incremental cost > $2k in rolling 6h, send paging to finance-oncall and pause non-essential background inference jobs.

kevin: Autoscale snippet I'll use (pseudoconfig):
```yaml
autoscale:
  max_gpus: 220
  burst_reserve: 40
  scale_up: 
    - condition: gpu_util > 85% for 2m
      action: add 10 gpus
  scale_down: 
    - condition: gpu_util < 40% for 10m
      action: remove 10 gpus
  fallback: route_to_fp_on_error: true
```

maria: One more operational note — KV-cache hit drop suggests cold cache penalty on latency-sensitive sessions. We should prioritize warming prefixes for conversational sessions (session type=chat). Kevin, please include an extra prewarm pass for session-type=chat when you run the prefetch job.

kevin: will do. Also enabling short-lived prefix caches (30s TTL) reduces memory pressure but improves hit-rate for streaming.

aj: Operational checklist I'll put in INF-4829: allocate burst GPUs, bump autoscale, enable routing + fallback, run KV prewarm, set cost guard, and run a 2-hour post-mortem after traffic stabilizes.

maria: Thanks team. If we see sustained traffic at these lengths for >48h we should discuss permanent dedicated capacity in EU and a pricing/commitment model with finance. For now, let's execute the hedge. :thumbsup:

sylvia: I'll pre-approve up to $3k for immediate hedging. Any spend above that needs rapid approval.

infra-bot: Action log created -> INF-4829, prewarm scheduled 09:00 UTC, burst allocation 40 GPUs, autoscale max bumped to 220 (temp).

kevin: I'll roll routing at 08:55 and watch logs. If latency > +150ms p95, I will roll back.

maria: meeting to sync at 10:30 UTC if still elevated. Thanks.
